sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Add a touch of regal elegance to your ethnic look with this stunning green Kundan choker necklace set. Designed with intricate enamel work, premium Kundan stones, and lustrous pearl drops, this jewelry set combines tradition with luxury. The necklace features multiple strands of green beads interwoven with pearls, creating a rich and graceful silhouette.
- The matching earrings mirror the same detailed square enamel design, embellished with Kundan stones and pearl danglers. Perfect for weddings, festive celebrations, haldi–mehndi functions, and traditional outfits, this choker set enhances both classic and contemporary styles.
- Crafted with high-quality materials and gold-tone detailing, this set is comfortable to wear and ideal for bridal, bridesmaid, and party looks.
